# Material Symbols Rounded

Google material-design-icons, Apache License 2.0; see LICENSE.

Pinned commit: 10ecc14790612ca8fd164e3f4ffe9c16fc50d5b7

Most Android VectorDrawable resources adapt the original SVG by setting a 960×960 viewport and translating Y by 960; the 24×24 exceptions below retain their original coordinates. Official path data is unchanged. The opaque black fill is intended to be tinted by the UI.
